title: Hands-on classes at Tampines Regional Library
summary: The cooking, maker-lab (MakeIT) and other hands-on classes the National Library Board lists at Tampines Regional Library, from a dated snapshot of NLB's public events search: a calendar and a list filtered by kind, dates, free or paid and audience, each class with its time, length, venue, ages, seats as NLB's page showed them and a Book on NLB link to its official GoLibrary page. Past classes are hidden by default; refresh.py regenerates the snapshot.
